camera.framing: Macro foreground focal point, deep lush forest background

foreground_element.geometry: 3D stylized smooth, glassy, multi-faceted angular crystalline nugget shape
foreground_element.placement: Sits prominently on a flat bed of dark, damp forest soil and moss particles

visual_properties.surface_texture: Glassy, smooth exterior faces with sharp light reflections and internal fluid flow line anomalies

terrain_features.description: Lush background forest dominated by massive prehistoric redwood and araucaria trunks. Several nearby tree trunks feature fresh, dripping layers of sticky, bright golden resin catching the sunlight, demonstrating the environmental genesis of the foreground amber card block.

background_environment.lighting: Strong directional shafts of sun-dappled forest light passing directly through the translucent foreground node, creating an intense, glowing internal fire effect and casting a warm golden caustic light pool onto the dark soil beneath.
